summary:
Fossil Free Banks campaigners protested outside banks nationwide, including about 20 people in Christchurch, calling for an end to lending to and investment in fossil fuels. Protester Michael Apathy said Kiwibank, TSB and Cooperative Bank were not currently financing fossil fuels but should guarantee they never would.

In Whitianga, plans are underway to remove three council-owned buildings known as Arlingham House and temporarily use the site as a car park. An assessment found serious deterioration and asbestos and lead-paint risks, estimating repairs at $475,000.
